method: Started from 1,610 priced Kalshi legs in the next 36 hours. Kept legs priced 30–85¢ with edge of about −2.5 or better and no flags, one per game, and matched them by hand against today's 166 collected expert picks (the dump again returned no automatic matches) and Polymarket top-trader positions. A leg stayed only if at least two of top-trader money, a published pick or model, and concrete matchup/injury news agreed, with nothing disagreeing. Dropped for conflicts: Bengals/Commanders (experts split 3–3 on the spread and top traders hold $87k on Commanders +6.5), 76ers ML/−4.5 (Covers and SI on Philly, top traders on Portland), Pacers ML/+4.5 (four outlets on Indiana, top traders heavier on OKC −4.5), Raptors −10.5 and Bulls +8.5 (sharp money vs a Pickswise/Covers pick the other way), Spurs and Lakers (a Covers or TheLines pick opposing), Devils (Dimers model opposite), Kraken (top traders on Anaheim), Islanders (small top-trader money on Toronto), Ole Miss/Clemson and Wild/Sharks (outlets split). Wolves/Nets Under 224.5 was skipped as too expensive (edge −3.0). Only seven legs passed, so the ladder is shorter than the usual 8–12; Tuesday's NBA and NHL games had no published picks yet.
honest: Every leg costs slightly more than its fair price (edge about −0.3 to −2.5¢ each), so expected return is slightly negative, and it gets worse with each leg you add.

ladder.label: Under 2.5
ladder.why: Brentford are without top scorer Igor Thiago (first game of a three-match ban) plus Nathan Collins and Aaron Hickey, and both defences are among the stingiest in the league (Brentford have conceded 11, Everton 10; Everton's five away games produced nine goals). Covers, GOAL and Bets.com.au all take Under 2.5; no top-trader money either way.

ladder.label: Memphis Grizzlies −3.5
ladder.why: Covers makes Grizzlies −3.5 its top pick even with Cameron Boozer and Jerami Grant out: Memphis is 8-1 against the spread on the road with a 20.1-point net-rating edge, while Charlotte has lost four straight and ranks last in eFG% and 3-point %. Top-trader money is on Memphis −3.5 ($4.2k for vs $1.2k against).

ladder.label: Phoenix Suns −3.5
ladder.why: Top traders hold $5.2k on Suns −3.5 against $1.8k on the other side. BetMGM's model takes Phoenix −3.5, and Covers still sees an edge on Phoenix even if Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy (both missed Saturday) return.

ladder.label: Montreal Canadiens
ladder.why: Montreal (14-6-4) starts Jacob Fowler (.918 save %) against Darcy Kuemper (.885) for a Kings team that is 7-12-2 and on the fourth game of a five-game road trip. Last Word on Hockey projects a 3-2 Habs win and the Fox Sports 990 model has 4-2; no meaningful top-trader money against.

sources.name: Last Word on Sports / Lori Bennett (Canadiens ML)

ladder.label: Houston Rockets
ladder.why: Houston (12-5) has won 7 of 8 at home and the Clippers are 0-7 on the road and 1-9 against .500+ teams. Covers projects Houston about 85%, SI includes the Rockets in its moneyline parlay and Pickswise lays −12.5; top traders $2.3k for vs $0.3k against.

sources.name: Sports Illustrated / Peter Dewey (Rockets ML, parlay leg)

ladder.label: Minnesota Timberwolves
ladder.why: Even without Anthony Edwards, Minnesota ranks No. 1 in defensive rating with a league-best 13-4 ATS record, while Brooklyn is 3-12 and 0-8 against .500+ teams. Covers and SI both back the Wolves to win; top traders $2.4k for, nothing against.

sources.name: Sports Illustrated / Peter Dewey (Timberwolves ML, parlay leg)

ladder.label: Eastern Michigan Eagles
ladder.why: Model-only leg for Tuesday: numberFire gives Eastern Michigan a 68.6% win probability and the 1390 The Gambler model projects EMU 28-19, noting Kent State is 0-5 ATS as a 5.5+ point underdog. No top-trader money either way, so this is the weakest leg.
